title: C¹ maps on open sets send Lebesgue-null sets to Hⁿ-null sets
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, let V ⊆ ℝⁿ be open, and let ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ be C¹ on V. If T ⊆ V has Lebesgue outer measure Lⁿ(T) = 0, then Hⁿ(ψ(T)) = 0, where Hⁿ = μHE[n] is applied as an outer measure.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (V T : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → T ⊆ V → volume T = 0 → μHE[n] (ψ '' T) = 0
